answer: Problem: Sybil clones inflate attestation tallies overnight. Mechanism: each fresh identity posts a vine-bond of 28 POA for 8 epochs and must complete a spiral of 5 timed micro-reviews scored by 3 non-kin peers; a sparrow sampler then rechecks one random review hash within 36h. Cost: 28 POA locked plus 0.4 POA per failed spiral step. Verification: vine-bond txid, three peer receipts, and sparrow sample all resolve on-ledger with scores ≥2. Failure: if the sample mismatches or the bond drops below 28 before epoch end, weight zeros until rebond.
